Test build, feature-edge derivation, determinism under shuffled input, no mutation, broken edges, cycles, the spec's edge cases, and the SC-001 timing on a 200-feature fixture
Test today's syntax: `depends-on: [US-1]` same-feature, `[015:US-2]` cross-feature, the `NNN/US-1` form, `blocked-by` as a distinct kind, and a node with no edges

Rebuild `analyzeGraph` on `buildGraph`; keep `resolveDepKey` as a re-export if other modules import it
Rebuild `attentionItems` and drop private `resolveDep`/`cycleKeys` in favor of the graph, preserving 020's behavior (`task-blocked` items, blocked tasks dropped from 'Up next')
Story-detail reverse edges read from the graph instead of re-filtering `dependsOn`

Implement `buildable(graph)` and `blockersOf(graph, key)` with today's `analyze` rule

Test against hand-computed graphs: buildable set, critical path, a done story unblocking dependents, equal-length chains stable, cycles excluded
Build the pure graph-view renderer as a plain text list: blockers, buildable, critical path, selected story
Add the `g` entry to the help overlay

Load graph-view and graph-paths only on the interactive path so one-shot and `--json` never import them
Test the view: content, jump to feature, narrow and plain-text fallback
Extend the one-shot perf test: the graph view is not loaded and the 1-second budget holds
Add the single shared graph to the architecture notes and list `graph` in the README command table

Final gate: `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass, and every FR in the spec has at least one test

Prove migration is safe
Measure token and readability cost
Deliver a decision others can build on

tasks.description: Create the scratch directory with a README stating how to run it and that nothing here ships
Build the repo and confirm `dist/core/dashboard.js` imports from a plain `.mjs`; record the Node version
Inventory every reader of status, depends-on, blocked-by and trailing file paths in `src/core` and `src/cli`, with file and line
Define the one comparable model: feature meta, stories, tasks with paths and phase verify, plus the format used per file
Write the baseline script that builds the v1 model for every spec through the built `parseStories` and `parseTasks`
Write the compare script: structural model diff that lists every differing field with its location
Hand-write v2 fixtures and v1 twins for the spec edge cases: cross-feature story link, clarification marker, CRLF, unusual path characters, malformed block, mixed formats
Implement the v2 reader: frontmatter through gray-matter, fenced yaml blocks through its yaml engine, errors carrying file and line
Implement the dispatcher that detects v1 or v2 per file and reports which parts of a mixed feature used which format
Run the reader over every fixture pair: twins give identical models and malformed inputs report their location
Run the reader over every real spec as v1 and compare with the baseline model
Implement migrate v1 to v2 for spec.md and tasks.md with the per-phase block layout, a dry-run diff summary, and skip-and-list for specs it cannot convert safely
Add the per-task block layout as a second migrate option
Dry-run over a temporary copy of `specs/` and prove nothing was written by hashing the tree before and after
Run migrate twice for real on the copy and prove the second run changes nothing and prose lines are unchanged
Read the converted copy in both layouts and compare with the baseline model
Run the current built parsers on the converted copy and record, per field, whether 1.x can still read it
Count characters, words and approximate tokens for at least three specs in v1, per-phase layout and per-task layout, and tabulate
Lane-merge experiment on a temporary git repo: two branches tick different tasks and edit different blocks, then merge, for each layout
Read the three converted samples and write the readability note: where prose or data hurt, and whether an assistant can load less than in 1.x

Write the decision with numbered decision IDs: chosen format and block layout, evidence by reference, risks to dashboard, analyze and the plugin API with how each is covered, and what specs 027 and 030 may assume
Cross-check the decision against spec 020 markers and the data spec 024 reads, and record any gap in the decision
Day-5 gate: if any task above is unfinished, write the partial findings and the unanswered questions into the decision and ask a person whether to extend
Confirm no shipped output changed: typecheck and the full test suite pass and the only changed paths are under `spikes/` and this spec directory
Delete the temporary specs copy and keep only results and scripts
